scope: Follow-up target API ergonomics/consistency audit; no runtime implementation/native passes; adaptation and returned-binding decisions superseded by explicit-routing-ruling.json

findings.decision: call!(target,Array,a) always declares a recorded position; Readback(previous_future) requests that output again. Standard eager Array(a) needs no new public eager readback future.
acceptance: Two recorded snapshots around a writer remain distinct before/after compilation; eager Array sees accepted work and never chooses a graph.
findings.superseded_decision: Readback array forms always declare a new position; Readback(previous_future) alone reuses an output.

findings.problem: Pending readback requests were owned/cancelled by a retiring plan
findings.decision: Graph owns pending output IDs/requests; compatible replacement rebinds them, submitted futures retain old staging.
acceptance: Request then grow/recompile then run: requested snapshot completes; submitted old snapshots remain intact; deletion/free rejects only unsubmitted requests.

findings.problem: Graph inspection had an eager-conversion detour and ambiguous host conversion semantics
findings.decision: Arrays own one Device. Eager Array needs no adaptation; a recorded position explicitly uses call!(Graph/Group,Array,a).
acceptance: Use one array directly in two graphs; their recorded Array calls select their own positions; eager Array(a) never executes either graph.
findings.superseded_decision: Graph-bound host conversions reject with Readback guidance; eager host snapshots remain direct; explicit Readback(graph,a) can inspect a retained same-domain root.

findings.problem: Scratch data initialization and snapshot/rebinding exceptions contradicted lifetime rules
findings.decision: Persistent data initializes once; explicit scratch initializer follows its construction region, while device identity never changes. Other regions reference it directly within valid lifetime.
acceptance: Scratch initialized per owner-region execution; explicit owner-local Readback holds independent staging; cross-run escape rejects.
findings.superseded_decision: Persistent data initializes once; explicit scratch-data construction initializes each execution of its owner region, including repeated iterations; owner-local scratch snapshots and rebinding inside the same owning Graph/run is legal.

findings.problem: Image examples/signatures mixed zero-based mips, color/depth defaults and undocumented window overload
findings.decision: Julia one-based image views infer an appropriate aspect; document window constructor; color volume example uses RGBA, preserving existing Float32 depth convention.
acceptance: Public mip 2 maps to native level 1 once; depth view never defaults ColorAspect; window extent refresh and color volume sample path qualify independently.

findings.problem: Inferred operation returned an eager destination after recording into a Group
findings.decision: The shared definition supplies returns: mul! returns C itself, recorded Array supplies a future; no Group-bound aliases, !-name inference or universal-future rule.
acceptance: call!(group,mul!,C,A,B) returns C; its KA backend stays its owning device; a known ! definition with another return follows that definition; unsupported f never eager-executes.
findings.superseded_decision: Both inferred and explicit-target entries return resolved-target aliases; original handles remain unchanged, broadcast forwards bound result.

findings.problem: Omitted keyword defaults were required in the literal API signatures
findings.decision: Document origin=nothing diagnostic default and hardware=nothing capability selection; explicit true requires hardware, false is software reference. Window, pipeline and ray-program optional defaults are explicit too.
acceptance: Existing no-origin dispatch and TLAS(dev) examples satisfy signatures; unsupported explicit hardware request fails before mutation.

findings.problem: Examples hid missing shape/initialization work and consumer helpers looked like Mantle API
findings.decision: Use app_* only for consumer helpers, actual window draw entry, deterministic sources, initialized simulation state and coherent full model resize. Import only LinearAlgebra.mul! to avoid its BLAS module colliding with Mantle.BLAS.
acceptance: All sketches parse as Julia; growing model initializes new persistent elements and resizes weights/workspace before replay; no invented graph_array entry.
Public examples do not import the conflicting LinearAlgebra.BLAS export; unqualified call names are documented entries, Base/selected stdlib calls, local definitions or explicit app_* placeholders.

findings.problem: Zero-copy rebinding said same physical device rather than ownership domain
findings.decision: Same Device/context domain is required; a second driver for the same hardware is a different domain and needs explicit transport/import.
acceptance: Reject same-physical-GPU different-driver alias; retain supported same-domain imports/aliases with canonical roots.

findings.problem: Unrequested readback outputs could continue transferring capacity-sized payloads
findings.decision: Core omits or gates unrequested payload transfers using existing region/segment machinery, without exponential output-subset recordings.
acceptance: Requested snapshot copies matching bytes/size; next run with no request copies zero payload bytes; report bounded control cost and recording/cache size across output counts.
